G10N.7.note: INFO permanently; no numeric EUI band exists anywhere in this project and Step 10 does not create one (D-S8-5 item 1(a))

G10N.8.inheritance: G10.8 verbatim, extended to the no-core N_u
G10N.8.note: per REAL dwelling zone (floor-averaged zones excluded, reported separately -- they carry no Step 7 diary of their own by construction), located by CONTENT (name + md5); the fold is read from each Step 7 bundle's own manifest.json, never from a filename

G10N.9.note: no building carries both arms. The executed campaign carries ARM D ONLY (0 Arm F cells were ever simulated -- see G10N.22); the check ran over the full 35,090-cell population and found zero violations, which is a real result, not a vacuous one, because the Arm D population it ran over is not empty.

G10N.10.note: reported, never gated even when evaluable (per FINDING 194); here it cannot be RE-MEASURED at all because the OpenUBEM geometry tree (openubem/geometry/european_residential.py) is not present in this checkout. V10N.i requires the check be re-measured, not copied from a prior review -- so this is reported NOT_EVALUABLE rather than carried from C1.

G10N.11.note: R3 in the campaign runner refuses Lyon/FR before anything else is read, and its eligible population is measured at 0 (§8.6 of the implementation doc); the executed campaign carries only es/uk/it, confirmed directly from every cell's own fold field.

G10N.12.note: only control-referenced RELATIVE deltas cross between steps; the banned list is the same absolute Step 8 / EU-basis EUI figures G10.12 refused (FINDING 120), reused unchanged since the Step 8 weather basis did not change with C2.

G10N.13.basis: the EMITTED CSV ON DISK, never the manifest's declared mean_phi_int_w_m2 (V10.h twin, FINDING 132)
G10N.13.note_on_bound: C1's fixed-decimal-derived bound does not apply here (measured: 0-12 decimals seen across the same population); a fixed 1e-6 relative bound is used instead, still far looser than the residues actually measured below.
G10N.13.population: the RETAINED run trees only (the campaign's own RETAIN_RUN_DIRS=4-per-batch policy; 217 directories carried a saved .idf out of 35,090 cells)
G10N.13.note: FINDING 132 is this failure at BUILDING level; per-zone is scored too because a per-zone failure can hide inside a correct building mean.

G10N.14.note: 0 blank fields across 35090 real cells, measured directly against the 15-field list of section 5 -- the C1 defect that flunked G10.14/G10.18 (5 manifest fields never written) does NOT reproduce here; the C2 runner writes all 15 fields per cell and refuses to write an incomplete manifest at all (MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE), so a cell that would fail this gate never reaches disk in the first place.

G10N.15.inheritance: G10.15, inherited OPEN as on the OpenUBEM side
G10N.15.note: G8.15 is closed on the OpenUBEM side under D-EU-29 for the campaign_149 perimeter only. This is a different population on a different basis, so zero FATAL/severe (there is no ENERGYPLUS_FAILED cell left in the executed population) is recorded as a measurement, never as a clean PASS.

G10N.16.basis: read back FROM THE SAVED IDF, scored PER ZONE
G10N.16.note: md5 + assignment arm, per zone. Floor-averaged zones are hash-checked against their own emitted file but are never checked against a Step 7 bundle -- they are not one.

G10N.17.basis: asserted from the SAVED IDF at the NAMED field position
G10N.17.note: FINDING 126: the old parser read the LAST comma-field; this reads the named position.

G10N.18.note: C1's G10.18 FAILED because no manifest ever carried the field at all (declaration arm unscoreable). C2's runner writes rotated_to_midnight=True on every cell as one of the 15 section-5 fields, so THIS twin scores the declaration directly rather than falling back to a phase reconstruction -- measured on all 35090 real cells.

G10N.19.inheritance: G10.19, floor reachable on census arithmetic only (§3.2)
G10N.19.note: UNLIKE C1 (es 9 / uk 5 / it 3 against 30, ruled FAIL-by-population in writing, Q1(a) 2026-08-28), the no-core population genuinely clears the pre-registered floor on every fold, measured directly: qualifying buildings (Arm D, Case B, completed, >=2 real distinct diaries, floor-averaged buildings excluded) = es 845 / uk 157 / it 1070, all >= 30. The threshold was not moved to reach this; the underlying population is simply larger on this basis.

binding_rule.note: a collision means >= 2 DIFFERENT presence files (real, distinct household diaries) produced a byte-identical emitted gain series at f > 0, where the injection is non-zero and no two diaries should ever coincide. This is the real-data equivalent of the scratch perturbation in 4thJ_10_nocoreRealStock_val.md ('two dwellings pointed at the same gain_sha256... must fell the binding gate'), found on real cells rather than manufactured.

G10N.20.note: cross-building delta_div is refused by construction: H10's deltas above are computed strictly WITHIN one building's own Case A / Case B pair, never across buildings.

clause_ii_case_a_cf_one.status: CARRIED, NOT SCORED ON SIMULATED POWER
clause_ii_case_a_cf_one.why_not_scored: identical reasoning to C1's own G10.21 scorer (4thJ_step10_realstock_score.py:gate_g10_21): on SIMULATED power the zones sharing one synchronised diary still differ in envelope area, orientation and solar exposure, so CF_A != 1 is physics, not a harness defect.
clause_ii_case_a_cf_one.AMBIGUITY_FLAGGED_FOR_THE_AUTHOR: the frozen val.md row for G10N.21 reads 'Case A CF!=1 is a harness defect | G10.21 verbatim' with no real-stock exception written on the C2 row itself, unlike C1's own scorer which carved this clause out explicitly. This file PORTS C1's carve-out (same physics, same simulated-power basis) rather than literal-scoring 660/404/851 cells (es/uk/it) as FAIL on grounds the C1 precedent already ruled were not a defect. If the author intends the C2 row to be read literally (no carve-out), this clause becomes FAIL, not CARRIED, on all three folds -- flagged rather than assumed.

G10N.21.note: verdict reflects clause (i) only, per the C1 precedent; clause (ii) is measured and reported, never gated.

G10N.22.note: the executed campaign never simulated an Arm F (one-box-per-floor fallback) cell -- every one of the 35,090 real cells is arm='D'. Arm F's projected population (75/12/175 buildings per the 2026-09-08 census) never reached a build_cells() row ('Arm D only. Arm F payloads never reached rows', 4thJ_step10_nocore_campaign.py). Reported as zero population, never a vacuous PASS on a direction claim that has no data to check.

G10N.23.note: no geometry remedy entered this campaign: the footprints are the census's own no-core cut, unaltered. A gate with an empty population has not been satisfied, it has not been ASKED. Reported VACUOUS, never as a pass.

G10N.replicate.note: section 6 of 4thJ_10_nocoreRealStock.md is explicit: 'No compute is authorised now; this section specifies the arm for when it runs.' No named subset was ever re-run R times on one host for the FINAL population. Population 0, reported, never a vacuous PASS.

cases.mutation: one diary's recorded md5 broken -- unlocatable by content
every bundle declares a fold its diaries did not come from
one building's f=0 cell made Arm F while its others stay Arm D
label one cell with a french fold
place an absolute Step 8 EUI beside a C2 figure
blank one manifest field on one real cell
flip rotated_to_midnight to False on one real cell
cap es qualifying buildings at 29 (below the 30 floor)
de-duplicate every real gain_sha256 collision (320 cells)
blank cf on one completed cell

mutation_battery.note: a gate that cannot be seen failing is not a gate. Two of these mutations are the INVERSE (G10N.19, G10N.20): the real data already passes/fails, so the mutation moves it the other way, which is what proves the scorer is sensitive rather than mechanically fixed.
